\begin{document}
The hybridization function is
\begin{equation}
\Delta(\omega) = \sum_{\substack{k \\ \sigma}} \frac{|V_{k}|^2}{\omega - \varepsilon_{k}} ,
\label{eq:hyb}
\end{equation}
which in the wide-band limit becomes
\begin{equation}
\Delta(\omega) = -\frac{i\Gamma}{2} .
\label{eq:wbl}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
